deduction_content: Spear head not travelling in a clearly defined arc
Rear handle of spear end protrudes from the grip
The thrusting arm and spear shaft do not form a horizontal straight line

questions.question: What is the error code for Zhā Qiāng (Spear Thrust)?
What are the deduction points for Zhā Qiāng (Spear Thrust)?
questions.answer: Deductions are applied when: 1) Spear head not travelling in a clearly defined arc, 2) Rear handle of spear end protrudes from the grip, 3) The thrusting arm and spear shaft do not form a horizontal straight line.
